title: Everywhere-defined left derived functors are exact
statement: Let $D$ and $D'$ be triangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category], let $F:D\to D'$ be an exact functor, and let $S$ be a saturated multiplicative system in $D$ compatible with the triangulated structure in the sense of [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization]. Let $Q:D\to S^{-1}D$ be an abstract localization with the universal property in [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization] (and the derived-category specialization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]). If the left derived functor $LF:S^{-1}D\to D'$ is defined at every object of $D$ in the sense of Definition Tag 05S9, then the functor $LF$ characterized by the universal property (equation derived-equation-everywhere) is exact as a functor of triangulated categories.

source.place: Definition Tag 05S9 (definition-derived-functor) and Proposition Tag 05SE (proposition-derived-functor), LF part

proof.text: Give LF coherent integer shifts and make alpha shift-compatible, using rightKanExtension_coherentShift. This is a generic right Kan universal-property construction; no pointwise-value object is chosen.

For each distinguished source triangle T, leftDerived_kan_map_source_distinguished identifies its image under Q composed with LF with the distinguished triangle of left-derived values. Consequently Q composed with LF is triangulated.

Use the left calculus of fractions in hS and Mathlib Localization.essSurj_mapArrow Q S. By Functor.distTriang_iff (the 05R6 localization-triangle statement), every distinguished T of L is isomorphic to Q.mapTriangle(T0) for a distinguished T0 of D. Apply LF.mapTriangle to that isomorphism and compose with mapTriangleCompIso. Closure under triangle isomorphism makes LF(T) distinguished, and gives LF.IsTriangulated.

proof_origin.place: Proposition Tag 05SE, LF part, assembled through coherent Kan shifts, source triangles, and the Mathlib 05R6 triangle-image criterion
